role.en: Director & Chief Scientist, Shanghai AI Laboratory; Chair Professor, Tsinghua
role.zh: 上海人工智能实验室主任兼首席科学家；清华大学惠妍讲席教授

why.en: Former head of JD AI and IBM Watson chief scientist. Organises the InternLM line and is one of China's principal voices on AI safety governance.
why.zh: 前京东 AI 掌门与 IBM Watson 首席科学家。书生 InternLM 与浦语系列的组织者，也是中国 AI 安全治理的主要发声者。

title.en: Towards AI4S 2.0: Intern-S1-Pro and the SAGE architecture
title.zh: 迈向 AI4S 2.0：Intern-S1-Pro 与 SAGE 架构

note.en: The 'specializable generalist' thesis: a feasible path to AGI.
note.zh: 「可专业化的通才」论点：一条通向 AGI 的可行路径。

title.en: Atria Dawn: The Dawn of Agentic Superintelligence
title.zh: Atria Dawn: The Dawn of Agentic Superintelligence

note.en: Bowen Zhou co-authored 'Atria Dawn', a large multi-institution Chinese report on agentic superintelligence, examining how AI agents that participate in developing their successors reshape research itself.
note.zh: 周伯文合著了《Atria Dawn》，这是一份由多家中国机构联合撰写的关于智能体超级智能的大型报告，探讨AI智能体参与开发其继任者如何重塑科研本身。

title.en: The Last AI Built by Humans: Toward Genuine Recursive Self-Improvement
title.zh: The Last AI Built by Humans: Toward Genuine Recursive Self-Improvement

note.en: Zhou co-authored a position paper on genuine recursive self-improvement in AI systems, arguing for turning experience into persistent capability gains beyond current training loops.
note.zh: 周伯文合著了一篇关于AI系统真正意义上递归自我改进的论文，主张让经验转化为超越当前训练循环的持久能力提升。

title.en: Autonomous Chemical Mechanistic Discovery through Agentic Reasoning and Validation
title.zh: Autonomous Chemical Mechanistic Discovery through Agentic Reasoning and Validation

note.en: Zhou co-authored a paper applying agentic LLM reasoning to autonomously discover and validate chemical reaction mechanisms.
note.zh: 周伯文合著了一篇论文，将智能体式大模型推理应用于自主发现并验证化学反应机理。

title.en: NCP-ArchPreview Technical Report: Moving towards Latent Space Language Models through Next Concept Prediction
title.zh: NCP-ArchPreview Technical Report: Moving towards Latent Space Language Models through Next Concept Prediction

note.en: Zhou co-authored the NCP-ArchPreview technical report from the Intern team, exploring latent-space language models built on next-concept prediction beyond token-level pretraining.
note.zh: 周伯文合著了Intern团队的NCP-ArchPreview技术报告，探索基于“下一概念预测”、超越token级预训练的潜空间语言模型。

title.en: DianShi-RxnDB: A Large-Scale, Fine-Grained Organic Reaction Data Platform Built via a Fully Automated Pipeline for Researchers and AI Agents
title.zh: DianShi-RxnDB: A Large-Scale, Fine-Grained Organic Reaction Data Platform Built via a Fully Automated Pipeline for Researchers and AI Agents

note.en: Bowen Zhou co-authored DianShi-RxnDB, a large-scale automated pipeline for building organic-reaction datasets for AI4Chemistry applications (with Shanghai AI Lab collaborators Dahua Lin and Conghui He, confirming this is his work and not a namesake).
note.zh: 周伯文合著了DianShi-RxnDB，一个用于构建有机反应数据集、服务于AI4Chemistry应用的大规模自动化流水线（合著者包括上海AI实验室的林达华和何聪辉，确认此为其本人成果而非同名者）。

title.en: Safin-1: Safety from Within through Memory-Native State Evolution
title.zh: Safin-1: Safety from Within through Memory-Native State Evolution

note.en: Co-authors Safin-1, a foundation-model architecture that embeds safety into the model's native memory and state-evolution mechanism rather than bolting it on externally.
note.zh: 合著Safin-1基础模型架构论文，将安全机制内嵌于模型原生的记忆与状态演化过程中，而非作为外部附加模块。

title.en: Understanding Cognition-Induced Risks in Agentic AI Systems
title.zh: Understanding Cognition-Induced Risks in Agentic AI Systems

note.en: Analyses risks that emerge from human-like cognition in LLM agent systems, in line with his AI safety agenda.
note.zh: 分析大模型智能体中类人认知带来的新风险，契合他主张的人工智能安全议程。

title.en: Intern-S2-Mobius: Foundation Model with Decoupled Knowledge and Reasoning
title.zh: Intern-S2-Mobius: Foundation Model with Decoupled Knowledge and Reasoning

note.en: Intern-series architecture that separates a shared knowledge memory from iterative reasoning modules.
note.zh: 书生系列的新架构，把共享的知识记忆与迭代推理模块解耦。

title.en: Towards general auditory intelligence for machine listening and speaking
title.zh: Towards general auditory intelligence for machine listening and speaking

note.en: Co-authored perspective in Nature Machine Intelligence on the path toward general auditory intelligence for machine listening and speaking, with Tsinghua, DeepMind and NVIDIA researchers.
note.zh: 与清华、DeepMind及NVIDIA研究者合著，发表于Nature Machine Intelligence，探讨迈向通用听觉智能（机器听说）的路径。

title.en: Intern-S2-Preview: Scientific Agentic Foundation Model
title.zh: Intern-S2-Preview: Scientific Agentic Foundation Model

note.en: Preview of Intern-S2, the lab's scientific agentic foundation model for reasoning over heterogeneous scientific evidence and tools.
note.zh: 书生 Intern-S2 科学智能体基础模型的预览版，面向多模态科学证据与科研工具的推理。

title.en: Distilling Physical Priors into Streaming World Models
title.zh: Distilling Physical Priors into Streaming World Models

note.en: Distils physical priors into streaming world models so long online rollouts stay physically coherent.
note.zh: 把物理先验蒸馏进流式世界模型，使长时在线预测保持物理一致性。

title.en: MinerU.Chem: A High-Precision System for Optical Chemical Structure and Reaction Recognition
title.zh: MinerU.Chem: A High-Precision System for Optical Chemical Structure and Reaction Recognition

note.en: Extends the lab's MinerU document-parsing system to optical recognition of chemical structures and reactions.
note.zh: 将实验室的 MinerU 文档解析系统扩展到化学结构式与反应式的光学识别。

title.en: The 2026 Singapore Consensus on Global AI Safety Research Priorities
title.zh: The 2026 Singapore Consensus on Global AI Safety Research Priorities

note.en: Co-authored international consensus document setting global AI safety research priorities, central to his role as a Chinese voice in AI governance.
note.zh: 他参与撰写的国际共识文件，提出全球人工智能安全研究优先事项，与他在 AI 治理中的角色直接相关。

title.en: Accurate, Interdisciplinary and Transparent Structure-property Understanding with Deep Native Structural Reasoning
title.zh: Accurate, Interdisciplinary and Transparent Structure-property Understanding with Deep Native Structural Reasoning

note.en: A structure-property reasoning model spanning biology, chemistry and materials, part of the lab's AI-for-science programme.
note.zh: 面向生物、化学与材料的结构-性质推理模型，属于实验室 AI for Science 方向的工作。

title.en: A Definition and Roadmap for World Models
title.zh: A Definition and Roadmap for World Models

note.en: Position paper that defines what counts as a world model and lays out a research roadmap for the area.
note.zh: 立场论文，给出世界模型的定义并提出该方向的研究路线图。

title.en: InternVLA-A1.5: Unifying Understanding, Latent Foresight, and Action for Compositional Generalization
title.zh: InternVLA-A1.5: Unifying Understanding, Latent Foresight, and Action for Compositional Generalization

note.en: Update to the lab's InternVLA robot model, unifying understanding, latent foresight and action for compositional generalisation.
note.zh: 实验室 InternVLA 机器人模型的升级版，统一理解、隐式预见与动作以提升组合泛化能力。

title.en: SciIR: A Large-scale Training Dataset and Benchmark for Scientific Image Reasoning Generation
title.zh: SciIR: A Large-scale Training Dataset and Benchmark for Scientific Image Reasoning Generation

note.en: SciIR is a large training set and benchmark for generating scientific images that must be semantically and logically correct.
note.zh: SciIR 是面向科学图像生成的大规模训练集与基准，要求生成结果在语义和逻辑上正确。

title.en: NatureBench: Can Coding Agents Match the Published SOTA of Nature-Family Papers?
title.zh: NatureBench: Can Coding Agents Match the Published SOTA of Nature-Family Papers?

note.en: NatureBench tests whether coding agents can reproduce and match the published state of the art from Nature-family papers.
note.zh: NatureBench 检验编程智能体能否复现并达到 Nature 系列论文中已发表的最好结果。

title.en: AMix-2: Establishing Protein as a Native Modality in Large Language Models
title.zh: AMix-2: Establishing Protein as a Native Modality in Large Language Models

note.en: AMix-2 makes protein a native modality in a language model, unifying protein understanding and sequence design.
note.zh: AMix-2 把蛋白质作为语言模型的原生模态，统一蛋白理解与序列设计。

title.en: VC-VTON: Toward Across-View and Multi-Posture-Driven Virtual Try-On via Spatiotemporal-Aware View-Consistency Training
title.zh: VC-VTON: Toward Across-View and Multi-Posture-Driven Virtual Try-On via Spatiotemporal-Aware View-Consistency Training

note.en: VC-VTON, a virtual try-on method with his Tsinghua group achieving consistency across viewpoints and poses.
note.zh: VC-VTON，与其清华团队合作提出的虚拟试穿方法，实现跨视角、跨姿态的一致性。

title.en: P1: Mastering Physics Olympiads with Reinforcement Learning
title.zh: P1: Mastering Physics Olympiads with Reinforcement Learning

note.en: P1, a Shanghai AI Laboratory model that masters physics olympiad problems through reinforcement learning.
note.zh: P1，上海AI实验室推出的模型，通过强化学习攻克物理奥赛题目。

title.en: SciTS: Scientific Time Series Understanding and Generation with LLMs
title.zh: SciTS: Scientific Time Series Understanding and Generation with LLMs

note.en: SciTS, a benchmark and method from his Shanghai AI Laboratory-linked team for scientific time-series understanding and generation with LLMs.
note.zh: SciTS，其上海AI实验室相关团队提出的基准与方法，用于大语言模型理解与生成科学时间序列数据。

title.en: InternBootcamp: Boosting LLM Reasoning with Verifiable Task Scaling
title.zh: InternBootcamp: Boosting LLM Reasoning with Verifiable Task Scaling

note.en: InternBootcamp, a Shanghai AI Laboratory project providing scalable verifiable tasks to boost LLM reasoning.
note.zh: InternBootcamp，上海AI实验室的项目，提供可大规模验证的任务以提升大语言模型推理能力。

title.en: Less is More: Efficient Model Merging with Binary Task Switch
title.zh: Less is More: Efficient Model Merging with Binary Task Switch

note.en: Less is More, an efficient model-merging method using binary task switches, from his Shanghai AI Laboratory-affiliated group.
note.zh: Less is More，其上海AI实验室关联团队提出的高效模型融合方法，采用二值任务开关。

title.en: Guest Editorial: Introduction to the Special Section on Large-Scale Multimodal Learning: Universality, Robustness, Efficiency, and Beyond
title.zh: Guest Editorial: Introduction to the Special Section on Large-Scale Multimodal Learning: Universality, Robustness, Efficiency, and Beyond

note.en: Guest editorial he co-wrote introducing an IEEE TPAMI special section on large-scale multimodal learning.
note.zh: 他参与撰写的IEEE TPAMI特刊客座编辑导言，主题为大规模多模态学习。

title.en: Efficient Diffusion Models: A Comprehensive Survey From Principles to Practices
title.zh: Efficient Diffusion Models: A Comprehensive Survey From Principles to Practices

note.en: A comprehensive IEEE TPAMI survey he co-authored on efficient diffusion models, from principles to practice.
note.zh: 他参与撰写的IEEE TPAMI综述，系统梳理高效扩散模型的原理与实践。

title.en: A Survey of Efficient Reasoning for Large Reasoning Models: Language, Multimodality, and Beyond
title.zh: A Survey of Efficient Reasoning for Large Reasoning Models: Language, Multimodality, and Beyond

note.en: A survey from his Shanghai AI Laboratory-linked team on efficient reasoning for large reasoning models across language and multimodal settings.
note.zh: 其上海AI实验室相关团队撰写的综述，探讨大型推理模型在语言与多模态场景下的高效推理。

title.en: Intern-S1-Pro open-sourced — a 1T-parameter multimodal scientific model
title.zh: 开源 Intern-S1-Pro —— 1 万亿参数多模态科学大模型

body.en: Built on SAGE, an architecture for integrating general and specialised capability. Zhou's framing: a 'specializable generalist' model is a feasible path to AGI.
body.zh: 基于 SAGE 架构，用于融合通用与专业能力。周伯文的表述：可专业化的通才模型是通向 AGI 的可行路径。

title.en: 周伯文：“AGI4S六问”之再思考，人工智能与科学发现，双轮驱动新范式变革
title.zh: 周伯文：“AGI4S六问”之再思考，人工智能与科学发现，双轮驱动新范式变革

body.en: Zhou laid out a reconsidered 'AGI4Science' framework, arguing AI and scientific discovery should drive a joint paradigm shift.
body.zh: 周伯文提出对“AGI4S六问”的再思考，主张人工智能与科学发现应双轮驱动新的范式变革。

title.en: 上海人工智能实验室主任周伯文：人类思考一道难题花了上百年，AI需要多久？
title.zh: 上海人工智能实验室主任周伯文：人类思考一道难题花了上百年，AI需要多久？

body.en: In an interview, Shanghai AI Lab's Bowen Zhou reflects on how long AI will need to match centuries of human problem-solving, a rare public window into his thinking on AI capability timelines and safety.
body.zh: 上海人工智能实验室周伯文在采访中谈到，人类思考一道难题耗费上百年，AI又需要多久，罕见地公开了他对AI能力发展时间线与安全问题的思考。

title.en: 上海人工智能实验室主任周伯文：人类思考一道难题花了上百年，AI需要多久？
title.zh: 上海人工智能实验室主任周伯文：人类思考一道难题花了上百年，AI需要多久？

body.en: Zhou discusses how long AI might need to solve problems that took humans over a century, a public reflection on AI capability timelines from Shanghai AI Lab's director.
body.zh: 周伯文谈到人类花费上百年才解决的难题，AI需要多久才能解决，这是这位上海人工智能实验室主任对AI能力发展节奏的公开思考。

title.en: 百年难题被智能体攻破！上海AI实验室主任周伯文：问题越古老，AI空间越大
title.zh: 百年难题被智能体攻破！上海AI实验室主任周伯文：问题越古老，AI空间越大

body.en: Zhou says Shanghai AI Lab's agents cracked a century-old problem, arguing the older the problem, the more room AI has to help.
body.zh: 周伯文表示上海AI实验室的智能体攻克了一个百年难题，认为问题越古老，AI能发挥的空间越大。

title.en: 上海人工智能实验室主任周伯文：科学研究是下一个编程
title.zh: 上海人工智能实验室主任周伯文：科学研究是下一个编程

body.en: Zhou Bowen, director of Shanghai AI Lab, argued in a Sohu interview that scientific research is becoming the next form of programming, framing AI as a tool for automating discovery.
body.zh: 上海人工智能实验室主任周伯文在接受Sohu采访时提出，科学研究正成为下一种“编程”形式，将AI视为自动化发现的工具。

title.en: 上海人工智能实验室主任周伯文：科学研究是下一个编程
title.zh: 上海人工智能实验室主任周伯文：科学研究是下一个编程

body.en: In an interview, Zhou Bowen argued that scientific research is AI's next frontier after programming, a framing tied to his role as a leading voice on China's AI research direction.
body.zh: 周伯文在采访中提出，科学研究将是继编程之后AI的下一个前沿，呼应他作为中国AI研究方向代表性人物的立场。

title.en: 上海人工智能实验室主任周伯文：科学研究是下一个编程
title.zh: 上海人工智能实验室主任周伯文：科学研究是下一个编程

body.en: Zhou argued in a Phoenix.com interview that scientific research is becoming the next programming — AI reframing how discovery itself gets done.
body.zh: 周伯文在凤凰网采访中提出，科学研究正成为“下一个编程”——AI正在重塑科研本身的方式。

title.en: 百年难题被智能体攻破！上海AI实验室主任周伯文：问题越古老，AI空间越大
title.zh: 百年难题被智能体攻破！上海AI实验室主任周伯文：问题越古老，AI空间越大

body.en: Zhou Bowen highlighted an AI agent's work cracking a decades-old open problem, arguing that the older the problem, the larger the space for AI-driven progress.
body.zh: 周伯文谈及智能体攻克一道存在已久的难题，认为问题越古老，AI能发挥作用的空间就越大。

title.en: 百年难题被智能体攻破！上海AI实验室主任周伯文：问题越古老，AI空间越大
title.zh: 百年难题被智能体攻破！上海AI实验室主任周伯文：问题越古老，AI空间越大

body.en: Bowen Zhou discussed an AI agent cracking a century-old open problem, arguing the older the problem, the larger AI's opportunity space.
body.zh: 周伯文谈及智能体攻克百年难题，认为问题越古老，AI能发挥的空间就越大。

title.en: 上海人工智能实验室主任周伯文入选2026《时代》AI百大人物- 中国日报网
title.zh: 上海人工智能实验室主任周伯文入选2026《时代》AI百大人物- 中国日报网

body.en: Named to TIME's 2026 list of the 100 most influential people in AI.
body.zh: 入选《时代》杂志2026年AI领域百大人物榜单。

title.en: 入选TIME100 AI，中国学者周伯文成为年度Thinkers
title.zh: 入选TIME100 AI，中国学者周伯文成为年度Thinkers

body.en: Zhou was named one of TIME's 100 Most Influential People in AI for 2026, recognized as a Thinker.
body.zh: 周伯文入选2026年《时代》AI 100人榜单，被评为年度Thinker。

title.en: 姚期智、薛澜、张亚勤、周伯文等专家共同担任《2026新加坡共识》报告指导委员会委员
title.zh: 姚期智、薛澜、张亚勤、周伯文等专家共同担任《2026新加坡共识》报告指导委员会委员

body.en: Zhou joins Yao Qizhi, Xue Lan and Zhang Yaqin on the steering committee for the 2026 Singapore Consensus report on AI safety.
body.zh: 周伯文与姚期智、薛澜、张亚勤等共同担任《2026新加坡共识》报告指导委员会委员，该报告聚焦人工智能安全。

title.en: 姚期智、薛澜、张亚勤、周伯文等专家共同担任《2026新加坡共识》报告指导委员会委员
title.zh: 姚期智、薛澜、张亚勤、周伯文等专家共同担任《2026新加坡共识》报告指导委员会委员

body.en: Zhou was named to the steering committee for the '2026 Singapore Consensus' report alongside Yao Qizhi, Xue Lan and Zhang Yaqin, a notable AI governance appointment.
body.zh: 周伯文与姚期智、薛澜、张亚勤共同担任《2026新加坡共识》报告指导委员会委员，这是一项值得关注的AI治理任命。

title.en: AI变强了，人类怎么办？周伯文：核心优势全在这三个词里
title.zh: AI变强了，人类怎么办？周伯文：核心优势全在这三个词里

body.en: Zhou lays out what he sees as humans' core remaining advantages as AI capabilities grow, in an interview with thepaper.cn.
body.zh: 周伯文在澎湃新闻的采访中阐述了他认为随着AI能力增强人类仍保有的核心优势。

title.en: 世界AI大会主持AI治理圆桌会议-周伯文 | 经信研究·经济和信息化
title.zh: 世界AI大会主持AI治理圆桌会议-周伯文 | 经信研究·经济和信息化

body.en: Zhou chaired the AI governance roundtable at the World AI Conference, consistent with his role as a leading voice on China's AI safety policy.
body.zh: 周伯文在世界人工智能大会上主持AI治理圆桌会议，延续了他作为中国AI安全政策重要发声者的角色。

title.en: 周伯文WAIC主旨演讲：迎接AI“科学元认知时刻”，发布“书生·端砚”平台
title.zh: 周伯文WAIC主旨演讲：迎接AI“科学元认知时刻”，发布“书生·端砚”平台

body.en: WAIC 2026 keynote in which he framed AI's "scientific metacognition moment" and launched the lab's Intern Duanyan platform.
body.zh: 他在 2026 世界人工智能大会作主旨演讲，提出 AI 的“科学元认知时刻”，并发布书生·端砚平台。

title.en: 周伯文WAIC主旨演讲：迎接AI“科学元认知时刻”，发布“书生·端砚”平台
title.zh: 周伯文WAIC主旨演讲：迎接AI“科学元认知时刻”，发布“书生·端砚”平台

body.en: In a WAIC keynote, Zhou described AI as reaching a 'scientific metacognition moment' and unveiled the '书生·端砚' platform.
body.zh: 周伯文在WAIC主旨演讲中提出AI正迎来"科学元认知时刻"，并发布了"书生·端砚"平台。

title.en: 文汇视讯｜周伯文：AI可以代表人行动，但不能代表人负责
title.zh: 文汇视讯｜周伯文：AI可以代表人行动，但不能代表人负责

body.en: Zhou argued AI can act on a person's behalf but cannot bear responsibility for them, a public stance on AI accountability from one of China's leading voices on AI safety governance.
body.zh: 周伯文提出AI可以代表人行动，但不能代表人承担责任，作为中国AI安全治理领域的重要声音之一，就AI问责问题公开表态。

title.en: 文汇视讯｜周伯文：AI可以代表人行动，但不能代表人负责
title.zh: 文汇视讯｜周伯文：AI可以代表人行动，但不能代表人负责

body.en: Zhou Bowen argued publicly that AI can act on a person's behalf but cannot bear responsibility for them, a governance stance from one of China's leading voices on AI safety regulation.
body.zh: 周伯文公开表示，AI可以代表人行动，但不能代表人负责——这是这位中国AI安全治理重要声音的一次公开表态。

title.en: 大方之谈丨对话周伯文：一个AI科学家的世界观
title.zh: 大方之谈丨对话周伯文：一个AI科学家的世界观

body.en: A long-form interview with The Paper in which he sets out his worldview as an AI scientist and his safety-first position on where the field should go.
body.zh: 澎湃新闻长篇对话，阐述他作为一名 AI 科学家的世界观，以及他“安全优先”的技术路线主张。

title.en: 周伯文团队提出NatureBench：AI撰写论文能否登上顶级期刊《自然》（Nature）？
title.zh: 周伯文团队提出NatureBench：AI撰写论文能否登上顶级期刊《自然》（Nature）？

body.en: Zhou's team proposed NatureBench, a benchmark testing whether AI-written papers can meet the standard required by top journals like Nature.
body.zh: 周伯文团队提出NatureBench基准，用于评估AI撰写的论文能否达到《自然》等顶级期刊的发表标准。
